findings.message: The criteria read the committed GO-grade report and its embedded verdict identity but never name the report path, its registered schema (`ReviewBaselineReport` / `REVIEW_BASELINE_REPORT` in `squatch/artifacts.py`), its machinery ticket (`go-grade-machinery`), or its producer ticket (`go-grade-run`). A committed-report read must name both machinery and producer.
findings.paved_road: Name `tickets/go-grade-run/review-baseline-report.json` (1,033 bytes, exists on main) in Scope in and the acceptance criteria, credit `go-grade-machinery` as machinery and `go-grade-run` as producer, and add the report to Context.

findings.message: The ticket says only 'run the registered host-loop producer'. It never names the producer module `eval/host_loop.py` (its `run()` entry returns `HostLoopReport`), the closed writers for `host-loop-report.json` and `exit-receipt.json` in `squatch/artifacts.py`, or their emitting ticket `exit-receipt-machinery`. The three closed host-loop members and the digest are therefore unanchored to any merged emitter.
findings.paved_road: Name `eval/host_loop.py` and its `run()` entry as the producer, and name the `HostLoopReport` / `HOST_LOOP_REPORT` / `EXIT_RECEIPT` writers in `squatch/artifacts.py` as the machinery landed by `exit-receipt-machinery`. The criteria should require the two fenced `tickets/phase6-exit/*.json` outputs to come from those writers.

findings.message: Context is empty even though the criteria depend on the contents of `squatch/artifacts.py` (11,787 chars: the report, receipt, and baseline schemas plus the closed host-loop member order), `eval/host_loop.py` (14,554 chars), and the committed baseline report. Without them the implementer cannot learn the closed member names or the verdict-identity field it must assert. Embedding all three adds about 27k chars to the 84,238 measured, which stays below the 120,000-char headroom.
findings.paved_road: Add `squatch/artifacts.py`, `eval/host_loop.py`, and `tickets/go-grade-run/review-baseline-report.json` to Context. Alternatively, name any of them as measured on-demand reads. Do not add them to the fence, because this ticket makes no engine-code edit.
